items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: We're talking about how Earl Hines was a big thing in Chicago coming on with Deep Forest.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Dick Allen still talking to Dono. And we're looking at this letter from William G.
Testing. January 1st, 1974. We're on the second side of this first reel of Don Alba. We're talking about how Earl Hines was a big thing in Chicago coming on with Deep Forest.

And George Foster would be on the piano and you could hear those knockers, click and click, click click click click click. And this guy blowing like Lil Armstrong. No horn, just making lifts. And this guy playing the bass, boom boom boom. And we'd stand, George Foster would cock his head on the side and say, you all hit? And one of the guys said, yes father, we hit. Keep going man. And they would play the whole tune of Deep Forest with no music coming out at all. And I'd be standing up there laughing, just dying…
